objective: Frozen computation: Metropolis samples of arrangements of 5 to 12 knots classified by the cluster rule, both weightings, growth spot checks, break-shape frequency.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (7 of 10 held; referee pending): by the cluster rule, among 8,000 sampled arrangements per knot count (5 to 20), stalls rise from 45% to 93% (open places per knot ~ sqrt(5/n)); among growers two-dimensional rises from 82% to 98%; rings at most 0.1% of growers; out of scope at most 0.4%; break shape 1 in 8,000; 998 of 998 in-scope spot checks equal the rule at 6 to 12 knots.
title: Shares by knot count, frozen
